related.cited.description: Prefix of a related page that writes a link to the current one.

related.clearAll.description: Link that lifts every type filter of the related pages.

related.filter.description: Placeholder of the text filter of the related pages.

related.fullList.description: Link to the fragment of every mention, offered before any script runs.

related.loadingOthers.description: Text of the button while the other related pages load.

related.noMatch.description: Notice shown when the filters of the related pages keep no page.

related.none.defaultMessage: No other page evokes this one yet.
related.none.description: Notice shown when no page cites the current one.

related.orderNote.defaultMessage: Ordered by number of passages, written and recognised together. “Cited” marks a link present in the text.
related.orderNote.description: Note under the related pages saying how they are ordered, written links and recognised mentions counted alike, and what the cited mark means.

related.other.description: Line that unfolds the one related page beyond the first three where the panel is condensed, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

related.others.description: Line that unfolds the related pages beyond the first three where the panel is condensed, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

related.othersUnavailable.defaultMessage: The other pages could not be loaded.
related.othersUnavailable.description: Status shown when the fragment of the related pages could not be fetched.

related.pagesOf.description: Count under the type filter, the two quoted placeholders being filled in the browser.

related.passage.description: Unit after the count of a related page holding one passage, for assistive technologies.

related.passages.description: Unit after the count of a related page holding several passages, for assistive technologies.

related.showOthers.description: Button that reveals the related pages beyond the served ones, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

related.title.description: Heading of the block listing the pages that evoke the current one.

related.types.description: Button opening the type filter of the related pages.
